name: @selecto/api-console
description: Dependency-free console for Selecto canonical domain APIs

scripts.build:all: npm run build --workspaces && npm run build
scripts.test: npm run build:all && node --test test/*.test.cjs && npm test --workspaces
scripts.pack:check: npm run test && npm pack --dry-run && npm pack --dry-run --workspaces && node scripts/pack-clients-check.mjs
